camel_example: aliyun bssopenapi ReleaseInstance --region cn-hangzhou --SubscriptionType PayAsYouGo --ProductCode ecs --InstanceIds 'rm-xxxxxxxxxxxx'
description_en: Releases instances by Virtual Network Operators (VNOs)
description_zh: 国家云虚商侧主动释放实例
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi release-instance --product-code ecs --subscription-type PayAsYouGo --instance-ids rm-xxxxxxxxxxxx --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReleaseInstance

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

Subscription: the subscription billing method.

PayAsYouGo: the pay-as-you-go billing method
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型

Subscription：预付费

PayAsYouGo：后付费
parameters.name: subscription_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 100 IDs can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。多个ID用英文逗号分隔，最大不超过100个
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
The method that is used to renew the instance. Valid values:

AutoRenewal: automatically renews the instance.

ManualRenewal: manually renews the instance.

NotRenewal: does not renew the instance
parameters.help_zh:
续费状态，取值：

AutoRenewal：自动续费

ManualRenewal：手动续费

NotRenewal：不续费
parameters.name: renew_status

parameters.help_en: The region in which the instance resides
parameters.name: region

HostId.description_en: The site of the execution host

ReleaseResult.description_en: Indicates whether the instance is released

Message.description_en: The description of the execution result

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 执行链路追踪字符串，排查问题时，可以提供给平台

Success.description_en:
A value of true indicates that the execution is complete.

A value of false indicates that an error occurs during the execution
Success.description_zh:
success=true代表调用执行完成

success=false代表执行出现错误
